subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported provider/model override contract, and if so should the contract be `payload.model`, top-level job fields, or an explicit `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public cron schema, session/provider precedence, persistence behavior, and upgrade expectations; automation should not choose that API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
options.body: Allow `payload.model` on `systemEvent` jobs and implement a transient per-run provider/model override with validation and wake-now/next-heartbeat proof.

options.title: Add an explicit job override block
options.body: Introduce a dedicated `sessionOverride` or top-level provider/model contract that can apply across payload kinds, accepting the broader schema/docs surface.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` jobs as the supported per-job model path and leave main-session system events tied to the target session's existing model state.

recommendation.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
recommendation.body: Allow `payload.model` on `systemEvent` jobs and implement a transient per-run provider/model override with validation and wake-now/next-heartbeat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron runtime and model-routing history makes this the best available routing owner for the API/product decision.
